import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Survival by passenger class and gender
survival_pclass_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_pclass_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 0], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
axes[0, 0].legend(['Female', 'Male'], title='Gender')
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival status
axes[0, 1].hist([df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna(), 
                 df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()], 
                bins=30, alpha=0.7, color=['lightgreen', 'salmon'], 
                label=['Survived', 'Did not survive'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend()
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fare distribution by passenger class
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == 1]['fare'], 
             df[df['pclass'] == 2]['fare'], 
             df[df['pclass'] == 3]['fare']]
box = axes[0, 2].boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, 
                         labels=['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'])
colors = ['lightblue', 'lightgreen', 'lightcoral']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Survival rate by embarkation port
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].mean().sort_values()
axes[1, 0].barh(range(len(embark_survival)), embark_survival.values, 
                color=['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue'])
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(range(len(embark_survival)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(embark_survival.index)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_xlim(0, 1)
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family size vs survival
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].mean()
axes[1, 1].plot(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, 
                marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='steelblue')
axes[1, 1].fill_between(family_survival.index, family_survival.values, 
                        alpha=0.3, color='lightblue')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Family Size', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(1, 12))
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Survival by age groups and gender
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['age'], bins=[0, 12, 18, 30, 50, 80], 
                         labels=['Child', 'Teen', 'Young Adult', 'Adult', 'Senior'])
age_group_survival = df.groupby(['age_group', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
age_group_survival.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 2], color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[1, 2].set_title('Survival Rate by Age Group and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 2].legend(['Female', 'Male'], title='Gender')
axes[1, 2].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
